observations.seen: Warm low-sun sky gradient in frames 2–3, but the station scene is lit flat. Building facades are evenly bright with little directional falloff, and there is no golden rim on the tram.
The tram casts only a faint soft contact shadow on the cobbles. Buildings and the platform canopy cast no readable shadows, and the pawn NPCs barely ground.
The tram roof shows glossy specular highlights that read as environment reflection, but the windows and rails show no coherent reflections of the sky.

Repeated photoscanned/textured building blocks with identical window grids. The floating sky track over a cloud sea with a distant island town is an evocative set piece. The station mixes stylized capsule pawns with realistic human figures.
Frame 3 has haze over the cloud sea and a distant town fading into sky. The street scenes have little depth fog, so distant buildings stay as crisp as near ones.
The tram has a convincing painted-lacquer look, but the cobblestone texture is visibly tiled. The clock tower texture is smeary and blurred, and building walls look like flat diffuse planes.
The tram model is detailed, with a trolley pole and windows. NPCs are mismatched: blank capsule pawns sit beside photoreal people. The barrel/crate props are low detail and the buildings are boxy.
In the chase frames the tram sits centered at roughly 15–20% of the frame with the arch and track leading lines. The station shot is cluttered, and a blue pawn foreground-blocks the bottom right.
The chase cam follows behind and above at a reasonable FOV. The low track-level view in frame 3 is strong, but the tilt-shift-like establishing shot has a soft blurred bottom.

Frame 4 shows tilt-shift/DOF blur at the frame edges, and frame 3 shows mild bloom and warm grade. Elsewhere the grade is muted and grey-brown without a cinematic film character; there is no visible grain or vignette.
Clean navy panels with a consistent font, a clear lean meter, and a passenger list. The control strip is long and dense, but legible.

nextChange.change: raise shadow strength toward the look target and pull the key light to an angle that throws visible contact shadows
